WHERE date BETWEEN '2024-11-01' AND '2024-11-30'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN win = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
       SUM(CASE WHEN win = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses
FROM team_games
WHERE team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'UConn Huskies%')
  AND season = 2024
  AND date < '2024-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM games
WHERE date BETWEEN '2022-12-01' AND '2022-12-31'
  AND ot_periods > 0

SELECT MIN(date) FROM games
WHERE season = 2022
